title: Finish the excerpt truncation fix

history.text: The activity feed is cutting emoji in half. The excerpt helper is in src/text.js. We ship build 02da1fda. I want the fix finished today, not another investigation.

I will read the helper and its tests first, then fix the truncation boundary. The rule I am working to: the returned string must never exceed max, and it must never split a UTF-16 surrogate pair. The ellipsis counts toward max.
